currentAssessment.homeRealmRecommendation: Keep POST /api/portal/sign-in/home-realm read-only for server persistence: parse and discard local part, resolve only enabled customer domain binding, return SSO/local without connection id and set a short-lived host-only HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax AEAD continuation cookie. A fixed portal initiation path consumes and clears the cookie, revalidates connection/domain binding, then calls factored existing OIDC start to create single-use state/nonce/PKCE. Clear stale cookie for local response, rate-limit anonymously, and record selected connection id only server-side. Store and compare immutable persisted organisationId in OIDC state/callback; the existing host-only HttpOnly state cookie binds the anonymous initiating browser, with no authenticated session prerequisite.
currentAssessment.externalAcceptance: Real Entra interoperability remains pending for IP-13/IP-27/IP-28/IP-31/IP-32; local home-realm omissions are local gaps, not external blockers.
